tiers.title: Foundations
tiers.goal: Explain how the power system works and reason with its numbers.
tiers.doord: Start with a game: run a small town's power plants for a day, then find out what you just did.

tiers.title: Analyst
tiers.reader: Undergraduates, career changers, and professionals from outside the power sector
tiers.goal: Work out costs, prices and trade-offs on paper and in a spreadsheet, and read an energy study critically.
tiers.doord: Costs, prices, storage and trade-offs, with numbers you can check yourself.

tiers.title: Modeler
tiers.reader: Upper-level undergraduates, graduate students and engineers
tiers.math: Programming and linear algebra (the math toolbox teaches what you need)
tiers.assumes: Analyst-level economics; the toolbox fills gaps in math and Python.
tiers.goal: Formulate, build, solve and critique an energy-system optimization model.
tiers.doord: From a first linear program to capacity expansion, uncertainty and research practice.

tiers.title: Researcher
tiers.reader: Learners who have finished the Modeler core, or graduate students starting a project
tiers.goal: Prepare for supervised research: design, run and communicate a study at one chosen scale, and form independent, well-founded views.
tiers.doord: Frame a question, find what is known, choose a method, check your model and defend a study.
